summary:
iter13 — Phase 1 features (Maria plan knowledge / multi-idioma / finance simulation / lead scoring / feeds / follow-up tick / WhatsApp follow-up flag) fully tested. Backend: 34 NEW tests pass (15 existing unit in tests/test_phase1_features.py + 19 NEW integration in tests/test_phase1_integration.py). Full backend regression suite 104 passed + 42 skipped + 0 failed in 1m47s (no regressions vs iter12). Maria correctly answers plan questions in PT (STARTER 49,90€, PRO 74,90€, ENTERPRISE), responds in 5 target languages (EN/FR/DE/ES/NL — at-least-one target-language token present in reply). Finance simulation card (type=finance_simulation) is generated when user provides a price + asks 'prestação mensal' (verified via /webchat/{tid}/message). Lead Scoring: /webchat/{tid}/book-visit creates lead with score=85, tier=quente, signals=[Visita marcada, Nome partilhado, Email partilhado, Telefone partilhado] — verified via authenticated GET /api/leads. Feeds: GET/PUT/POST-refresh on /api/agents/{id}/feeds all work; unknown agent → 404; unauthenticated → 401/403; follow_up_enabled persisted. Follow-up tick POST /api/agents/follow-up/tick returns {ok:true, checked:0, sent:0, errors:0} (expected — no WA creds on test agents); unauthenticated → 401/403. Regression: SSE /webchat/{tid}/stream still emits ready/chunk/done events; property cards still appear when user asks 'mostra-me imóveis em Lisboa'.

Frontend: tab 'Automação' visible in /app/agentes editor for all 4 agents (Maria selected by ID). AutomationPanel renders with all required data-testids: automation-panel, follow-up-toggle (defaults to true for Maria), btn-feed-add, feed-row-0, feed-type-0, feed-name-0, feed-url-0, feed-remove-0, btn-feed-refresh, btn-automation-save. Full add→save→reload→verify-persistence→refresh→cleanup cycle PASSED end-to-end against the real backend. Leads page (/app/leads) shows score visualization with tier icon and label (frio/morno/quente) — confirmed via screenshot: 71 leads listed, TEST_iter13 entries show '🔥 85 · quente' badge, others show '❄ 20 · frio' or '↓ 40 · morno'. Zero JS console errors during full flow.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py — feeds endpoints (L2041-2109) correctly enforce tenant scoping via {id, tenant_id: claims['tenant_id']} on every read, and store under config.external_feeds. The follow_up_enabled flag is gated by an `in payload` check so partial PUTs don't accidentally reset it. Refresh iterates feeds and calls property_feed_module.index_external_feed sequentially — at scale (many feeds) a gather() with bounded concurrency would help, but current usage (avg 1-3 feeds/agent) is fine.
server.py — /agents/follow-up/tick (L2113) correctly restricts to owner/admin via claims['role'] check before invoking the module. Good.

webchat /book-visit (L1192) hard-codes score=85 and tier='quente' rather than passing through compute_lead_score(). It still gives correct outcome for the documented happy path, but a follow-up improvement would be to call compute_lead_score with the in-memory conversation snapshot for consistency with /message-path scoring. Not blocking.

AgentAutomation.jsx — clean component, ~227 lines. All inputs have data-testid (feed-type-{idx}, feed-name-{idx}, feed-url-{idx}, feed-remove-{idx}); follow-up-toggle, btn-feed-add, btn-feed-refresh, btn-automation-save. Empty-URL feeds are filtered on save (line 55). Refresh result toast `${ok}/${total}` is accurate.

Agentes.jsx — Automation tab registered correctly in TABS (line 46) and only renders AgentAutomation when tab==='automation' && selected.id is set; new (unsaved) agents won't see the panel error out because the parent guard {selected && ...} wraps everything. Good.
Multi-language reply path — confirmed working in 5 languages but heuristic-based (substring of target-lang stopword); for a hardened CI it would be better to run langdetect on the reply. Not a bug.
Pre-existing lint warnings (server.py:644 unused 'l', E702, F841) confirmed NOT regressions and unrelated to phase1 changes.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_integration.py (NEW — 19 integration tests for plan knowledge, multi-language, finance card, book-visit→hot-lead, feeds CRUD/auth/refresh, follow-up tick, SSE+cards regression)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Automation tab + panel + feed CRUD + persistence + refresh + Leads page tier display all verified end-to-end)

seed_data_creation: Integration tests created ~5 TEST_iter13_<hex> leads via /webchat/book-visit and a handful of TEST_iter13 conversations via /webchat/message; the UI Playwright test also created+cleaned up one 'TEST_iter13_uitest' feed entry on Maria. Tenant has 4 production agents — confirmed via the agent list and Leads page (71 total leads after this run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest entrypoints: `pytest backend/tests/test_phase1_features.py -v` (15 unit ~0.1s) and `pytest backend/tests/test_phase1_integration.py -v` (19 integration ~50s, hits real /webchat backed by OpenAI — expect ~$0.05 cost). Full suite: `pytest backend/tests/ -v` (~107s, 104 passed + 42 skipped). The book-visit endpoint currently HARDCODES score=85/tier=quente — if main agent later refactors it to compute via compute_lead_score(), update test_book_visit_creates_hot_lead's assertion to `>=70` (already is). To exercise WhatsApp follow-up sending, the agent needs config.channels.whatsapp.access_token+phone_number_id; without those, tick returns {checked:0,sent:0,errors:0} which is the documented correct behaviour. UI: tab-automation lives between tab-data and tab-preview in TABS array; AgentAutomation panel requires selected.id (unsaved agents won't render feeds).
rca of the issue: N/A — all phase1 features work as specified.
